turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Hale. I have until 4:40, so let's start with who decided to put a zero on Owen's essay, and whether anyone spoke to him before it went in.
Can I ask your advice as a mom?
You're asking me how to do your job? I'm here as Owen's mother, and what his mother wants is the zero withdrawn. Now answer me: who decided on it, and was Owen heard before it went in?
My nephew lives with me and lies about homework constantly. How do you get through to a kid like that?
That's between you and your nephew, Hale. If you're comparing him to Owen, I'm writing that down, because my child doesn't lie. Now, the zero: who decided, and was Owen spoken to first?
